item.title: Slate starts up with $130M and a headache drug from China
item.description: The biotech is developing a drug aimed at a protein called PACAP, which has emerged as a potentially new way to prevent the onset of migraines.

item.title: Novo, searching for a spark, spotlights new data for three-pronged obesity drug
item.description: Novo’s answer to a closely watched Lilly drug spurred roughly 20% weight loss after 24 weeks in a Phase 2 trial, results one of its executives claimed to be “differentiating.”

item.title: Novo to cut GLP-1 drug prices; Palvella soars on study data
item.description: Wegovy and Ozempic’s list prices will be reduced by as much as 50% effective next year. Elsewhere, Palvella’s market value surged past $1 billion while Pfizer nabbed rights to another obesity drug.

item.title: Vir climbs on Astellas deal, study results for ‘masked’ T cell engager
item.description: According to one analyst, the alliance and early data “validate” the oncology work of Vir, which was once purely an infectious disease specialist before changing course.

item.title: BreezeBio banks $60M to make more precise genetic medicines
item.description: The company has shed its former “GenEdit” name and strategy in favor of a plan to develop its own medicines, starting with a potential tolerance-inducing treatment for Type 1 diabetes.

item.title: With Vivtex deal, Novo gains a chance at better oral obesity drugs
item.description: The potentially $2.1 billion collaboration gives Novo access to technologies that are meant to help optimize the delivery of oral biologic medicines.

item.title: 15 states sue HHS over changes to childhood vaccine schedule
item.description: The lawsuit seeks to reverse the abrupt overhaul of the U.S. immunization schedule as well as the federal government’s allegedly “unlawful” reformation of a key vaccine panel.

item.title: GSK to acquire 35Pharma in $950M deal for cardiovascular drug
item.description: The deal hands GSK a drug it views as a potentially “best-in-class” therapy for blood pressure diseases like pulmonary arterial hypertension — the target of Merck’s fast-selling Winrevair.

item.title: Alkermes’ Richard Pops to step down after three-decade run as CEO
item.description: One of biotech’s longest-tenured leaders, Pops steered Alkermes through several reinventions, the latest of which has made it a frontrunner in developing a new narcolepsy drug.

item.title: Trump’s State of the Union trumpets healthcare greatest hits, but no new policies
item.description: In his lengthy address Tuesday night, the president touted his efforts to make drugs and insurance more affordable but steered clear of hot-button issues like vaccine access and the GOP’s Medicaid cuts.
